units.zh: 吾雖寡德，過蒙先帝列將之授，以數郡之人，尚欲併吞強虜，是以自頃迄今，交鋒接刃，一時務農，三時用武，而猶師徒不頓，倉有餘粟，敵人日畏，我境日廣，況乃王者之威，堂堂之勢，豈可同年而語哉！
units.en: Though deficient in virtue, I undeservedly received appointment as one of the former emperor’s generals. With the people of only several commanderies, I still aspire to engulf powerful enemies. Thus, from recent times until now we have crossed weapons in battle, farming for one season and fighting for three; yet our troops are not exhausted, our granaries have surplus grain, our enemies fear us more each day, and our territory grows daily. How much greater, then, are imperial majesty and its imposing power—how could the two be compared!
units.literal: Though deficient in virtue, I undeservedly received the former emperor's appointment among the generals; with the people of several commanderies I still wish to swallow powerful enemies; therefore from recent times until now, crossing weapons and meeting blades, one season for farming and three for war, yet the troops are not exhausted, the granaries have surplus grain, the enemy fears us more each day and our territory grows daily; how much greater, then, are imperial majesty and its imposing power—how could the two be compared!

units.zh: 其年皝伐高句麗，王釗乞盟而還。
units.en: That year he invaded Goguryeo; King Gao Zhao sued for peace and he withdrew.
units.literal: That year Huang campaigned against Gaogouli; King Gao Zhao begged a covenant, and Huang returned.

units.zh: 明年，釗遣其世子朝於皝。
units.en: The next year Gao Zhao sent his heir to pay homage to Huang.
units.literal: The next year, Zhao sent his heir apparent to court at Huang.

units.zh: 三年，遣其世子俊與恪率騎萬七千東襲夫餘，克之，虜其王及部眾五萬餘口以還。
units.en: In the third year he sent his heir Jun and Ke with seventeen thousand cavalry to raid Puyu eastward; they took it, captured its king and more than fifty thousand of the tribe, and returned.
units.literal: In the third year, sent his heir apparent Jun with Ke leading cavalry seventeen thousand east to raid Puyu, took it, captured their king and division host over fifty thousand mouths and returned.
